title: Para Bellum content: the engine vocabulary
description: File: Content/vocabulary.json. Lists the engine-level names content files may use: stat keys, resource pools, unit types, facility kinds and settlement types. THE GAME NEVER READS THIS FILE TO DECIDE BEHAVIOUR. It describes the code; it does not extend it. A test in the game asserts that it equals the code exactly, so editing it cannot add a stat, a pool or a unit type. Adding one is a code change, by design.

_comment.description: The header. It must carry the rule that the game never reads this file to decide behaviour. This key is the ONE EXPLICIT EXCEPTION to the content rule that unknown keys are refused (PB-C105): it is legal in this file only, and it is declared here rather than left implicit.

facility_kinds.description: The engine facility kinds, in the code's declaration order, spelled exactly as facility.json's kind values.

settlement_types.description: The settlement types the map produces, none included.
